A LITTLE ROOM TO SLOW DOWN

Just outside
the everyday.

Tucked inside District Park in Janakpuri, Eatery Royale brings the table outdoors. There’s greenery all around, a gazebo to settle into, and no reason to rush.

Come for lunch with the family or an evening with friends. In winter, there are bonfires and garden heaters; in summer, mist fans keep the air comfortable.
